overview: CapRL introduces a reinforcement learning framework with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for image captioning, utilizing a decoupled VQA pipeline where a vision-free LLM answers MCQs based on the generated caption to provide an objective reward signal, training LVLMs to produce dense and accurate captions without supervised fine-tuning limitations.

modules.name: Image Data Collection and Preprocessing
modules.description: Handles the collection of diverse images (natural scenes, charts, documents) and applies rigorous filtering, including semantic deduplication, resolution checks, safety screening, and benchmark leakage prevention.

modules.name: QA Pair Generation and Leakage Filtering
modules.description: Generates multiple-choice question-answer pairs for images using a large vision-language model, followed by a strict filtering process to ensure questions are visually grounded and cannot be answered using external knowledge or question cues alone.

modules.name: Decoupled VQA Reward Calculator
modules.description: Computes the objective reward for generated captions by feeding them along with MCQs to a vision-free LLM, implementing option shuffling and multiple sampling to calculate an averaged accuracy score as the verifiable reward.

modules.name: GRPO Policy Optimization Engine
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm for RLVR, managing policy model updates using the computed VQA rewards, calculating group advantages, and applying KL-divergence penalties for training stability.

modules.name: Caption Generation Inference
modules.description: Executes inference using the trained policy model to generate rich, dense, and accurate captions for input images, serving as the core generation component.

modules.name: Scalable Caption Dataset Construction Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the large-scale inference process using the trained captioning model to annotate a massive corpus of images, producing the final large-scale dense caption dataset for downstream pretraining.

modules.name: Multimodal Pretraining and Alignment Pipeline
modules.description: Executes the multi-stage training process for LVLMs, encompassing initial visual-language alignment, further pretraining using the generated dense caption dataset, and supervised fine-tuning to evaluate the utility of captions.

modules.name: Prism Framework Evaluation Module
modules.description: Assesses caption informativeness by decoupling visual perception and linguistic reasoning, using a fixed text-only LLM to answer questions based solely on the generated captions.

modules.name: Comprehensive Benchmark Evaluation Module
modules.description: Runs evaluations across a suite of standard vision-language benchmarks (e.g., document understanding, chart QA, general VQA) and computes accuracy metrics to compare performance against baselines and SOTA models.

modules.name: Ablation Study and Analysis Framework
modules.description: Manages and executes controlled ablation experiments, varying factors such as the number of QA pairs per image, reward sampling rounds, answer model sizes, and domain-specific training data to analyze their impact.

modules.name: Training Stability and Reward Monitoring
modules.description: Tracks and logs training dynamics, including reward distributions, caption length trends, and gradient statistics, specifically monitoring for and mitigating reward hacking behaviors like verbosity or brevity biases.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration Manager
modules.description: Handles the loading and management of configuration files for different model architectures, training stages, dataset variations, and evaluation settings to ensure experimental reproducibility.
